title: WCLI-186 follow-ups: three test and runbook cleanups from the #422 review
description: Three non-blocking items from the #422 round-2 review: (1) the stale "unset" wording in the comment at test/release-workflow.test.ts near the requirement-step test (the unset case was dropped); (2) hoist one trace-scan regex const so the positive controls and the assertions in the no-sign-step-traces test use the same regex; (3) docs/runbooks/publish-a-mac-signed-ward-release-asset.md: the set-key-partition-list note is a failure signature, not a green-log item. Paths: test/release-workflow.test.ts, docs/runbooks/publish-a-mac-signed-ward-release-asset.md. No behaviour change.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The requirement-step test comment no longer mentions an unset team id case
One trace-scan regex const is used by the assertions and by the positive controls
The runbook describes the set-key-partition-list message as a failure signature, outside the list of things a green log must show
